regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, semiconductor-led leadership cluster (Memory/HBM & Storage, AI Infrastructure, WFE) atop the US thematic ranks, with the absolute-trend gate helping on this market's history (gate_helps true). Rotation breadth is narrowing (0.43 eligible) with no one-narrative dominance, and the backtest verdict frames rank-IC as ~0 — so these are attention/focus reads, not return forecasts; my leans are expressed as falsifiable conditionals.
emerging_watch: Watching for a CONFIRMED handoff from the semiconductor cluster (Memory/HBM & AI Infrastructure, both proxied by SMH) toward Non-AI Tech & Hardware (rank 8, durability_bar 0.89, breadth 0.923, trend-tagged). The observable that would advance this watch: Non-AI Tech & Hardware's momentum score overtakes AI Infrastructure's score while XLK holds its 50-day moving average.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks 4th on momentum with the highest durability_bar (0.81), full breadth (1.0), and a hurst_tag of 'trend' — but it also carries the highest crowding_z (1.91) and a crowded=true flag. Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade; I express this as an underweight-avoid rather than a short, since the rank itself is attention, not alpha.
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is the only trend-tagged theme in the top ranks with perfect breadth and high durability — the crowding flag has no basket-level forward edge and fading a genuinely durable leader is the documented failure mode.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks to a fresh 30-day relative high versus SPY despite the crowded flag

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM & Storage is the rotation leader (score 2.59) and headline theme, eligible with a durability_bar of 0.70 and broad participation (breadth 0.75). It is not crowded (crowding_z 0.41). The trend-gate is the one validated leg and this theme clears it; momentum rank itself is only a focus lens, so the lean is conditional on the trend holding rather than a return forecast.
theses.dissent: hurst_tag is 'mixed' (not trend), val_state is 'diverging', and cross-sectional momentum has rank-IC ~0 — the leadership is real attention but may not carry a return edge.

falsifier.text: SMH trades below its 50-day moving average while Memory/HBM & Storage's relative score drops below AI Infrastructure

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the rotation challenger (score 2.132, margin 0.458 behind the leader), eligible with the highest breadth in the top cluster (0.875) and durability_bar 0.71, not crowded (0.78). It shares the SMH proxy with the leader so the two read as one semiconductor cluster; I lean overweight on the cluster but flag this as a focus read, not a return call.
theses.dissent: Same SMH proxy as the leader means this is not an independent bet, and cross-sectional momentum has no forward edge — a crowded, narrow leadership cluster can unwind together.

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% over the next 30 days
